exerciseDetails.name: Plank
exerciseDetails.description: Hold forearm plank position keeping body in a straight line.

exerciseDetails.name: Advanced plank
exerciseDetails.description: Hold a plank with variations such as arm/leg lifts for increased intensity.

exerciseDetails.name: One legged plank
exerciseDetails.description: Hold a plank position while lifting one leg off the ground, maintaining a straight line from head to heels.

exerciseDetails.name: Side plank
exerciseDetails.description: Lie on your side, prop up on one forearm, lift hips to form a straight line from head to feet, and hold.

exerciseDetails.name: Side plank left
exerciseDetails.description: Lie on your left side, prop up on your forearm, lift hips to form a straight line, hold position.

exerciseDetails.name: Side plank right
exerciseDetails.description: Lie on your right side, prop up on your forearm, lift hips to form a straight line, hold position.

exerciseDetails.name: Side plank leg up
exerciseDetails.description: Hold a side plank position and lift the top leg upward, keeping your core engaged throughout.

exerciseDetails.name: Plank rotation
exerciseDetails.description: Start in a plank position, rotate your torso and extend one arm toward the ceiling, then return and repeat on the other side.

exerciseDetails.name: Plank ups
exerciseDetails.description: Move from forearm plank to high plank and back, alternating one arm at a time.

exerciseDetails.name: Plank switches
exerciseDetails.description: Alternate between high plank (hands) and low plank (forearms) positions by moving one arm at a time.

exerciseDetails.name: Plank leg lifts
exerciseDetails.description: In plank, lift legs alternately keeping hips stable.

exerciseDetails.name: Plank stars
exerciseDetails.description: From plank, lift opposite arm and leg outwards forming a star shape.

exerciseDetails.name: Arm leg plank
exerciseDetails.description: In plank position, lift opposite arm and leg simultaneously and hold briefly.

exerciseDetails.name: Crunches
exerciseDetails.description: Lie on your back, bend knees, lift your upper body toward your knees using your abs, then return slowly.

exerciseDetails.name: Bicycle crunches
exerciseDetails.description: Lie on your back, lift shoulders off the ground, and alternate touching elbows to opposite knees in a pedaling motion.

exerciseDetails.name: Butterfly crunches
exerciseDetails.description: Lie on back, bring soles together, perform crunches touching feet or ankles.

exerciseDetails.name: Jump crunches
exerciseDetails.description: Crunch up explosively while simultaneously jumping your feet off the floor.

exerciseDetails.name: Sit ups
exerciseDetails.description: Lie on your back, bend knees, and lift your upper body all the way up to a sitting position, then lower slowly.

exerciseDetails.name: Punch sit ups
exerciseDetails.description: Perform a sit up and punch forward at the top of the motion.

exerciseDetails.name: Lower abs
exerciseDetails.description: Lie flat on your back, lift your legs toward the ceiling, then slowly lower them without touching the ground.

exerciseDetails.name: Isometric lower abs
exerciseDetails.description: Hold legs slightly above the floor, keeping lower abs engaged.

exerciseDetails.name: Scissors
exerciseDetails.description: Lie on your back, lift legs slightly, and alternate crossing them over each other in a scissor motion.

exerciseDetails.name: Seated tucks
exerciseDetails.description: Sit on the floor, lean back slightly, pull your knees toward your chest, then extend your legs outward without touching the floor.

exerciseDetails.name: Ankle taps
exerciseDetails.description: Lie on your back with knees bent, lift your shoulders slightly, and tap each ankle by bending sideways.

exerciseDetails.name: Russian twists
exerciseDetails.description: Sit with feet off the floor, twist torso side to side while holding hands together or a weight.

exerciseDetails.name: Windshield wipers
exerciseDetails.description: Lie on your back, lift legs, and rotate them side to side like wipers.

exerciseDetails.name: Power tucks
exerciseDetails.description: Jump and tuck knees to chest, landing softly before repeating.

exerciseDetails.name: Single leg crunches
exerciseDetails.description: Perform crunches while keeping one leg raised and alternating sides.

exerciseDetails.name: Plank kicks
exerciseDetails.description: From plank, lift legs alternately in a kicking motion.

exerciseDetails.name: Jackknife twists
exerciseDetails.description: From lying position, lift legs and torso, twisting to touch toes or sides.

exerciseDetails.name: 3 way crunch pulses
exerciseDetails.description: Pulse your torso in three directions to engage all areas of the abs.

exerciseDetails.name: Low abs twists
exerciseDetails.description: Lie on back and twist lower body side to side while legs lifted.

exerciseDetails.name: Low abs bent knees
exerciseDetails.description: Raise bent knees toward chest while lying on back, lowering slowly.

exerciseDetails.name: Side plank leg circle
exerciseDetails.description: Hold side plank and move top leg in controlled circles.

exerciseDetails.name: Seated leg raises
exerciseDetails.description: Sit with legs extended and lift them together while leaning back slightly.

exerciseDetails.name: Circle crunches
exerciseDetails.description: Perform crunches moving your torso in a circular motion.

exerciseDetails.name: Plank buzzsaw
exerciseDetails.description: From plank, rotate hips side to side rapidly while keeping torso stable.

exerciseDetails.name: Jackknives
exerciseDetails.description: Lift legs and torso simultaneously to meet in a jackknife position.

exerciseDetails.name: Full arm side plank leg up
exerciseDetails.description: In side plank, lift top leg and extend top arm overhead.

exerciseDetails.name: Lateral abs
exerciseDetails.description: Perform side crunches or twists to target lateral abdominal muscles.

exerciseDetails.name: Scissor drops
exerciseDetails.description: Alternate lowering legs in a scissor motion without touching the floor.

exerciseDetails.name: Plank jacks
exerciseDetails.description: Jump legs in and out while holding a plank position.

exerciseDetails.name: High plank
exerciseDetails.description: Hold plank position with hands under shoulders and body straight.

exerciseDetails.name: Low plank
exerciseDetails.description: Hold a forearm plank keeping body straight and engaged.

exerciseDetails.name: Knee to elbow
exerciseDetails.description: From plank, bring knee to opposite elbow alternately.

exerciseDetails.name: Leg raises
exerciseDetails.description: Lift legs straight up from the ground while lying on your back.

exerciseDetails.name: Pushups
exerciseDetails.description: Start in high plank, lower your chest toward the floor, and push back up while keeping your core tight.

exerciseDetails.name: Knee pushups
exerciseDetails.description: Perform pushups on knees with proper form, lowering chest to floor.

exerciseDetails.name: Diamond pushups
exerciseDetails.description: Form a diamond with hands and perform pushups targeting triceps.

exerciseDetails.name: Decline pushups
exerciseDetails.description: Elevate your feet and perform pushups to target upper chest and shoulders.

exerciseDetails.name: Hindu pushups
exerciseDetails.description: Start in a downward dog position, swoop your chest low and forward while bending elbows, then return to the starting position.

exerciseDetails.name: Staggered pushups
exerciseDetails.description: Place one hand slightly forward and one back, perform pushups alternating sides for balance.

exerciseDetails.name: Pushup rotation
exerciseDetails.description: Do a pushup, then rotate your torso and raise one arm towards the ceiling for a side plank position.

exerciseDetails.name: Pushups rotation
exerciseDetails.description: Do a pushup and rotate into side plank, alternating sides.

exerciseDetails.name: One leg pushups
exerciseDetails.description: Perform pushups while keeping one leg lifted for extra core and balance challenge.

exerciseDetails.name: Spiderman pushups
exerciseDetails.description: As you lower in a pushup, bring one knee toward your elbow. Alternate sides each rep.

exerciseDetails.name: Archer pushups
exerciseDetails.description: Keep one arm extended while lowering toward the opposite arm, mimicking an archer's draw motion.

exerciseDetails.name: One arm pushups
exerciseDetails.description: Perform pushups with one arm while keeping your core engaged and feet spread for stability.

exerciseDetails.name: Explosive pushups
exerciseDetails.description: Perform pushups explosively so your hands leave the floor. Land softly and repeat.

exerciseDetails.name: Pushups on fist
exerciseDetails.description: Perform pushups on your fists for added wrist stability and forearm strength.

exerciseDetails.name: Knee tap pushups
exerciseDetails.description: Perform a push-up, then tap your knee with the opposite hand before starting the next rep.

exerciseDetails.name: Pushups toe touch
exerciseDetails.description: Perform pushups and touch one hand to opposite foot at the top.

exerciseDetails.name: Pushups full rotation
exerciseDetails.description: Do a pushup and rotate your body into a side plank before returning.

exerciseDetails.name: Tiger band pushups
exerciseDetails.description: Perform pushups with resistance band around upper back for extra tension.

exerciseDetails.name: Clap pushups
exerciseDetails.description: Perform explosive pushups and clap hands at the top.

exerciseDetails.name: Sphinx pushups
exerciseDetails.description: From forearm plank, lower and push up keeping elbows tucked.

exerciseDetails.name: Isometric pushups
exerciseDetails.description: Hold the low position of a pushup as long as possible, keeping your body straight.

exerciseDetails.name: Pushups half squat
exerciseDetails.description: Do a pushup, then return to standing with a half squat before next repetition.

exerciseDetails.name: Shoulder taps
exerciseDetails.description: In plank position, tap each shoulder alternately keeping core tight.

exerciseDetails.name: Spiderman
exerciseDetails.description: In a pushup position, bring knee toward elbow alternating sides.

exerciseDetails.name: Pike pushups
exerciseDetails.description: Start in a pike position with hips up, bend elbows to lower your head toward the ground, then push back up.

exerciseDetails.name: Handstand pushups
exerciseDetails.description: Perform pushups while in a handstand position against a wall for support.

exerciseDetails.name: Dips
exerciseDetails.description: Lower your body using parallel bars or a bench and push back up, keeping elbows close to your body.

exerciseDetails.name: One leg dips
exerciseDetails.description: Perform dips while extending one leg forward or backward.

exerciseDetails.name: Dips toe touch
exerciseDetails.description: Do dips and at the top reach one hand toward your opposite toe.

exerciseDetails.name: Jumping sit outs
exerciseDetails.description: Start in a bear crawl position, lift one hand and opposite leg, rotate your body and kick the leg through, then return and repeat.

exerciseDetails.name: Australian pullups
exerciseDetails.description: Hang under a bar, pull your chest toward the bar, then lower slowly while keeping your body straight.

exerciseDetails.name: Hyperextensions
exerciseDetails.description: Lie face down, lift your chest and legs off the ground by contracting your lower back, then slowly return.

exerciseDetails.name: Squats
exerciseDetails.description: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, lower hips back and down as if sitting in a chair, then return to standing.

exerciseDetails.name: Jump squats
exerciseDetails.description: Perform a squat, then jump explosively, landing softly and returning to squat position.

exerciseDetails.name: One legged squat
exerciseDetails.description: Perform a squat on one leg while keeping the other leg extended forward, maintaining balance.

exerciseDetails.name: Side squat
exerciseDetails.description: Take a wide stance, shift your weight to one side as you bend the knee and keep the other leg straight, then switch sides.

exerciseDetails.name: Butterfly squats (explosive)
exerciseDetails.description: Start in a squat position, jump explosively and tap your feet together mid-air, then land softly back into the squat.

exerciseDetails.name: Lunges
exerciseDetails.description: Step forward with one leg, lower your hips until both knees are bent at about 90 degrees, then push back to start.

exerciseDetails.name: Jump lunges
exerciseDetails.description: Lunge forward, jump explosively, switch legs mid-air, and land softly.

exerciseDetails.name: Bottom up lunges
exerciseDetails.description: Step forward into a lunge, then drive back to standing, focusing on pushing from the heel and engaging glutes.

exerciseDetails.name: Single leg deadlifts
exerciseDetails.description: Stand on one leg, hinge at the hips keeping back straight, and lower your torso toward the floor, then return upright.

exerciseDetails.name: Single leg chair stands
exerciseDetails.description: Sit on a chair, extend one leg, then stand up using only the other leg, keeping balance controlled.

exerciseDetails.name: Tuck jumps
exerciseDetails.description: Jump explosively while pulling your knees toward your chest, land softly, and immediately go into the next jump.

exerciseDetails.name: Super skater jumps
exerciseDetails.description: Jump laterally from side to side, landing on one leg with the other leg sweeping behind for balance.

exerciseDetails.name: Side kicks
exerciseDetails.description: From plank or standing, perform controlled side kicks.

exerciseDetails.name: Hip thrusts
exerciseDetails.description: Sit on the ground with your back against a bench, feet flat, and lift hips upward by squeezing your glutes.

exerciseDetails.name: Donkey kicks
exerciseDetails.description: Start on all fours, lift one leg upward while keeping your knee bent at 90 degrees, then lower and repeat.

exerciseDetails.name: Lateral donkey
exerciseDetails.description: Start on all fours, lift one leg to the side while keeping your knee bent, then lower back down and repeat.

exerciseDetails.name: Burpees
exerciseDetails.description: From standing, squat down, kick your feet back into a plank, perform a pushup, return to squat, and jump explosively upward.

exerciseDetails.name: Burpees (no pushup)
exerciseDetails.description: From standing, squat down, kick your feet back into a plank, quickly return to squat, and jump explosively upward.

exerciseDetails.name: Half burpees
exerciseDetails.description: Perform burpees without the jump, always keeping the hands on the floor (i.e a pushup followed by a half quat).

exerciseDetails.name: Side burpees left
exerciseDetails.description: Perform a burpee keeping the right leg always raised.

exerciseDetails.name: Side burpees right
exerciseDetails.description: Perform a burpee keeping the left leg always raised.

exerciseDetails.name: Mountain climbers
exerciseDetails.description: Start in plank position, alternate driving knees toward your chest quickly while keeping your core tight.

exerciseDetails.name: Jumping jacks
exerciseDetails.description: Jump with your legs spreading outward and arms going overhead, then return to the starting position quickly.

exerciseDetails.name: Run in place
exerciseDetails.description: Run on the spot, lifting knees high and pumping your arms.

exerciseDetails.name: Knee up run
exerciseDetails.description: Run in place bringing knees up towards chest to increase heart rate.

exerciseDetails.name: Jump rope
exerciseDetails.description: Jump rope continuously, keeping a steady pace and engaging your calves and core.

exerciseDetails.name: Inchworms
exerciseDetails.description: Stand tall, hinge at the hips to touch the floor, walk your hands forward into a plank, then walk them back and stand up.

exerciseDetails.name: Squat taps
exerciseDetails.description: Perform a squat and tap one foot to the side, alternating sides.

exerciseDetails.name: Squat run
exerciseDetails.description: Alternate between squats and short running steps in place.

exerciseDetails.name: Step in
exerciseDetails.description: Step one foot forward and back repeatedly as a light warmup.

exerciseDetails.name: High knees
exerciseDetails.description: Run in place while lifting knees as high as possible, pumping arms.
